text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Phew~... I'm home~

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Welcome home, Craft.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Ah! That soft, airy tone of voice...!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It might be a bit plain for a snack, 
but... Would you like some pickled radish?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It has citric acid, so it's good for 
fatigue. Ah, but dinner's soon, so don't 
have too much, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yay, sweet, off-duty Cesarioâª Alright, 
down the hatch!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Mmm~♪ Sho yummy...♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, thank goodness. ...Still, you 
really work hard until you're exhausted 
every day, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Is your debut race coming up soon?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. We're deciding on the course at our 
next meeting!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"How about Cesario? Is she taking a break 
until winter after all?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
You're right. It's only mild inflammation, 
but an injury is an injury, so no 
overdoing it.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—However, it might have been for the best. 
Many of the summer debut races are shorter 
than what suits my aptitude, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(! Her demeanor snapped into place! That's 
Cesario switched "on"...!)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Craft. Did you tell the 
Trainer your preferences regarding the 
track for your debut race?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Knowing you, I expected you to say you 
wanted to run the same courses as your 
Triple Tiara seniors, though."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, yeah! I was actually thinking I 
wanted to tell you all about that, 
Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Which one should I go for? Maybe Hanshin 
Turf 1400m, or even Tokyo Dirt 1400m—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: WHAAAATTTT!?!?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Kyoto, Turf, 1400m... is that right!?
choice_data_list:
Ah, yeah, I was thinking it might be good 
for your debut...

Y-Yeah, I was wondering how it'd be for 
the debut race...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Her reaction is so overwhelmingly 
intense that it makes me, the one who 
suggested it, flinch a little."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A shorter distance of 1,400m seemed like a 
good fit, and Kyoto's track makes it easy 
to build speed, so I brought it up 
thinking it was ideal, but...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please!! That's definitely the one!! 
Kyoto!! Turf!! 1,400 meters!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: B-But, but, but, doesn't that mean—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't that the course Sweep Tosho-san ran 
and won on...?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho, whose name had suddenly come 
up, was a year ahead of Rhein Kraft... 
meaning she was an Umamusume entering the 
Classic Class this year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she possesses a devastating late 
kick, she's built quite a reputation—in 
more ways than one—for her stubborn, 
self-centered personality, but—
choice_data_list: (I see, she's on the Tiara route too...!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes! She placed 5th in the Oka Sho to make 
the board, and amazingly took 2nd in the 
Oaks—she's an incredibly talented 
senior...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
From her debut, Sweep-san ran two 
consecutive races at Kyoto 1400m! And 
what's more, she won both back-to-back!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Especially in the Fantasy Stakes, sweeping 
from the far outside with the fastest 
final stretch time!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Her running was truly like magic... and 
it stole everyone's attention!!"
choice_data_list:
So Sweep's also one of those admired Tiara 
Uma Musume, huh

So Sweep's also one of those admired Tiara 
Uma Musume, huh

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Besides, Sweep-san is—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, no! This is hardly the time for me 
to be chatting away like this.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Because for my debut race, I'm running 
the Kyoto Turf 1400m!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I get to debut on the same course at the 
same distance as Sweep-san, after all. I 
need to train lots and lots!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I absolutely, positively refuse to run a 
pathetic race...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Just like Sweep-san!! I'll show everyone 
a run that gets their hearts racing, 
too!!"
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's get right to training!
Yeah. Let's get right to training!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes, I look forward to working with you!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaahhhhh—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, full of spirit, Rhein Kraft 
powered through the days leading up to her 
Debut... and the big day had finally 
arrived!
